title: Fast-paced & Precise Mouse-only Roguelike [Preview]
author: Top-Hovercraft2326
selftext:
Currently in development! AI has been used for everything (*Visuals temporarily*) besides **Game Design** and the **Creative Process**.

Planning to release an early version of it very soon, or if this post garners enough attention. Feel free to DM if you have any questions or want to support the project.

Keep in mind - this is a **Pre-Alpha**. Everything is subject to change (although most things won't change, of course), and a lot of the Enemies especially aren't designed for the early-game Player experience. Progression isn't fully developed. I want this to be a preview more than anything. Someone out there is working on a large-scale, unique roguelike with AI - let that be known.

comments.author: Lextrot
comments.body:
Don't really understand what's going on, bunch of shapes zooming around.  
I know the v*isuals are WIP but what is the game about?*

replies.author: Top-Hovercraft2326
replies.body:
Yeah, my bad. The trailer here really is way too fast. Here's an earlier compilation of clips I had that's more decipherable to say the least: [https://files.catbox.moe/0mo5q3.mp4](https://files.catbox.moe/0mo5q3.mp4) . Scrapped it because it didn't compile the best clips to show the game (especially enemies) off, but I underestimated how much some people may struggle to read what is going on.

The title describes it as simply as possible. It's a character-based, action, mouse-only (as in - you move with the mouse, meaning movement is instant and precise) roguelike. It'll have its fair share of unique mechanics, but I can best compare it progression-wise to a mix of TBOI, RoR2, and Shape of Dreams (barely). If you want to know more, feel free to DM/ask (early ver of the game will release with a How to Play section anyway, just an fyi).
